name: Charles Lee and his family at the Lee house by the river mouth
head: lee_charles

present_on_scene_date.note: In the fort from the April alarm (Quaife ch. X).

associated_with.note: The family's town house on the lake shore near the fort (Wau-Bun ch. XIX).

not_in_this_household.note: Liberty White and Jean Baptiste Cardin, killed at Lee's Place on 6 April 1812, died before the scene date. Russell, said to be Lee's partner, is not placed at Chicago in August by any source read.

persons.name: Charles Lee

occupation.note: His farm on the South Branch, where Liberty White and Jean Baptiste Cardin were killed on 6 April 1812.

present_on_scene_date.note: No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

also_written: Leigh (Helm, Forsyth spell the family so)
persons.note: Farmer (Lee's Place); said to have held the provision contract. Quaife thinks he was one of the twelve militia; killed 15 Aug. The given name Charles is in Currey only. After 14 August: Killed 15 Aug.

evidence.locator: pt. III "The Tragedy", PG 52346 lines 2243-2244

present_on_scene_date.note: No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

persons.note: Farm hand; possibly militiaman. Escaped the April attack at Lee's Place; killed 15 Aug. Quaife's April account has the boy unnamed and does not call him Lee's son. After 14 August: Killed 15 Aug. Wau-Bun has Lee's son killed with him; that he served in the militia is Quaife's inference.
